start: Settings, Branding, in a gym with the member app on and no look saved yet

user_sees: Title 'Branding' with 'Your gym's logo and colours in the MettleUp app. Your logo also shows at the top of this admin app.'
'Loading your gym’s look…' then the form with a phone preview
must_not: A form that shows another gym’s colours
The form reloading and wiping picks every few seconds

steps.action: Tap 'Upload logo' and pick a logo on a plain white box
user_sees: 'Checking your logo…' then two logos side by side: 'Without the background' (Best for the app) and 'Keep my logo as it is'
Button 'Upload this logo'
must_not: The picked logo lost when the file window closes
A logo over 1 MB accepted without a word

steps.action: Pick a colour under 'Your brand colour', tick 'Use my own background tone', choose 'Bold italic' headings
user_sees: The phone preview changes at once
'Easy to read?' lists what was checked, and says when a colour was changed so it can be read
must_not: A half-typed colour code breaking the preview
Save open while the code is not a colour

user_sees: 'Saving…' then 'Saved. New members see it at once. Members who already joined see it on a later visit to the app. The app checks at most once an hour, and never in the middle of a workout.'
The logo shows at the top of the admin app at once
'Saved' with the date beside the button
must_not: Saved shown when the server refused
A different colour stored than the one picked
The look of another gym changed

user_sees: 'Finish typing the colour code to check it.'
'Save' is off
must_not: The half code saved
The preview going blank

steps.action: Pick a logo that is a photo or has a pattern behind it
user_sees: 'Your logo has a photo or a pattern behind it.' with free ways to remove it
The logo kept as it is
must_not: A cut-up logo saved as if cleaned

user_sees: 'Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again.'
Every pick still on the form
must_not: The toast 'Saved.'
Picks wiped by the failure

user_sees: The page does not open for staff
must_not: Staff able to change the look
The server accepting a staff save

start: Branding with a look already saved

steps.action: Change the colour but do not save, switch to another window and come back
user_sees: The unsaved pick is still on the form
must_not: The form reset to the saved look by the background refresh

user_sees: 'Save' is off and 'Saved · <date>' shows
must_not: Save left on with nothing changed

steps.action: Tap 'Use MettleUp’s look', confirm in the sheet 'Go back to MettleUp’s look?'
user_sees: 'Back to MettleUp’s look.'
The logo leaves the top of the admin app
The 'Use MettleUp’s look' button goes away
must_not: The old logo still shown to members for good
The clear done without the question

user_sees: The new look saved as in the happy path
must_not: The cleared logo coming back by itself

steps.action: Join the gym in the member app on a phone
user_sees: The app shows the gym's name, logo and colours
must_not: Another gym's logo or colours
The look changing in the middle of a workout

steps.action: Look at who can see the logo file
user_sees: The logo is a public picture: anyone with its address can open it
Only the owner can change it
must_not: A logo address that names the gym id or the owner
Staff or a member able to change the look
